comparison.objective: Rotate a suspended humanoid torso 180° and stop it; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Momentum control and gentle arrest of a freely swiveling load versus coaxial tool seating, angular adjustment, and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Torso remains within 10° and under 1°/s without a blow; candidate retains a 90° opening within 3° across three cycles with at most 2° drift.
comparison.reason: The record tests dynamic load arrest, not coupled screw-and-locknut adjustment or retained calibration.
